review.description: S1-S3 retain verified subscriptions, stable retry identity and host-specific delivery acceptance. Correctly reducing false attention and emitting matching resolution events uses the existing event contract.
review.implementation: Event subscription and delivery services are unchanged. Reviewed matching synthetic retirement and native replacement events for run entity identity and transaction boundaries; native and approval delivery policies remain. Approved CI trigger selection now runs pushes only on main and retains PR-to-main/manual events. Exact comparison, fixture, bootstrap and main-push release implementations are unchanged; feature branches without PRs and manual parent-base limitations are documented. Matching async/text sibling retirement emits attention.resolved inside the same Store.Write as terminal status/history changes; unrelated request/run identities remain unchanged. Current cycle changes only failed synthetic delivery cancellation and disconnected awaiting-answer takeover in questions.go. Reviewed this consumer against those narrow changes; its authored behavior and implementation remain consistent, with existing gaps retained.
review.tests: Read TestSubscriptionVerificationRetryDedupRefreshAndExpiry signature, entity-filter, same-event retry, acknowledged no-replay and expiry assertions. New legacy tests assert emitted matching attention.resolved events; real host notification gaps remain.
